name: CloudFilt
description: A security middleware that checks each visitor's IP against the CloudFilt service to block bots, scrapers, Tor, spam and DDoS traffic.
project_description:
Back to top 

 Overview 
 This module integrates Drupal to CloudFilt service. CloudFilt helps businesses to protect their websites, webapps and APIs from bot traffic, tor traffic, web fraud, DDoS and more.

 Full protection of your websites, webapps and APIs

Prevent, block & stop bad bots:

 
 Bot traffic 
 Anti-Fraude 
 Web Scraping 
 Tor traffic 
 Spam Submissions 
 IP reputation & IP Risk Score 
 Web Fraud 
 Business logic 
 Denial of service (DDoS) 
 Protection from automated threats 
 
 Back to top 

 Getting started 
 After installing the module as usual , go to the configuration page ( /admin/config/services/cloudfilt ) to setup your public and private keys. 

 Optionally you can select specific useer roles to be skipped by the CloudFilt checking (e.g. you may want not to check requests from users logged in as Administrator, making your CloudFilt dashboard cleaner).
